description_en: We have a 2+1+2 apartment for sale in Univers city. Univers City is the newest multifunctional residential complex in Tirana. Univers City will be the community that will offer you the peace, relaxing atmosphere, safety, ease and comfort of a small town. Location: 2 minutes from QTU, 4 minutes from "Military Hospital", 10 minutes from "Skenderbey" Square. Information about the apartment: - Gross area: 98.66 m2 - Net area: 86 m2 - Floor 6 Organization: - Living room and kitchen - 2 Bedrooms - 2 Toilets - 2 Balconies Other features: • New construction • Elevator • Hood system • Building with high design and construction standards • Acoustic and thermal wall insulation, thermal and double-glazed windows • Incaso plumbing • With contemporary infrastructure and community organization • School and public kindergarten • Health center • Various sports fields with professional parameters • Central park • Sports corner • Playground for children • The apartment will be ready for occupancy by the end of 2026. • For more information, contact us!
